params.name: page
params.description: The zero indexed page of results. A mimimum value of 0 will be accepted.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. The default value is 5000. A mimimum value of 1 and a maximum of 10000 will be accepted.

params.name: schedule_types
params.description: The comma-delimited list of schedule types to include. Will return all schedule types if not provided.

params.name: recent_changes_72hrs
params.description: When true, only includes entities added or updated in the last 72 hours

items.docs:
Get the list of schedulable entities within the developer's Zocdoc directory (provider-locations, etc.) with availability information.

NPIs can be used to search for providers in the /v1/providers endpoint to facilitate availability, discovery, and booking. Schedulable entity ids can be used to find provider-locations in the /v1/provider_locations/{provider_location_id} endpoint to facilitate availability, discovery, and booking.
